topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The morning sun splashes gold over everything, and the air is fresh, almost singing as it whispers through the leaves. My steps are light on the path, and I pause, noticing the world seems a little brighter today. I find myself humming a tune as I approach the place where I've been creating, and there it is—my work, altered, adorned with lines and hues I did not place there myself. Yet, instead of the weight I expected, there’s a curious spark. It’s like the world decided to join in, to dance and play alongside what I've created. I smile, thinking of the unseen hand that dared to dream alongside mine. Today feels like one of those days where the unexpected is simply a delightful surprise, woven into the fabric of the day.
